The '''2023–24 Scottish Premiership''' (known as the '''[[Cinch (company)|cinch]] Premiership''' for sponsorship reasons) was the eleventh season of the [[Scottish Premiership]], the highest division of [[Football in Scotland|Scottish football]], and the 127th edition overall of the top national league competition, not including one cancelled due to [[World War II]]. The season began on 5 August 2023.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://spfl.co.uk/news/key-dates-for-season-202324 |title=Key dates for Season 2023/24 |publisher=Scottish Professional Football League |date=21 December 2022 |access-date=16 April 2023}}</ref>

Twelve teams contested the league: [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]], [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]], [[Dundee F.C.|Dundee]], [[Heart of Midlothian F.C.|Heart of Midlothian]], [[Hibernian F.C.|Hibernian]], [[Kilmarnock F.C.|Kilmarnock]], [[Livingston F.C.|Livingston]], [[Motherwell F.C.|Motherwell]], [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]], [[Ross County F.C.|Ross County]], [[St Johnstone F.C.|St Johnstone]] and [[St Mirren F.C.|St Mirren]].

On 15 May 2024, Celtic successfully defended their title, securing a tenth Premiership title and 54th Scottish league title overall, following a 5–0 victory away to [[Kilmarnock F.C.|Kilmarnock]].<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cyj332ne237o|title= Rodgers 'never had any doubt' about Celtic title challenge|date=15 May 2024|work=BBC Sport |accessdate=16 May 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.theguardian.com/football/article/2024/may/15/celtic-crowned-scottish-premiership-champions-kilmarnock-match-report|title= O'Riley double helps Celtic thrash Kilmarnock and clinch 54th league title|date=15 May 2024|newspaper=The Guardian |accessdate=16 May 2024}}</ref>

==Format==
In the initial phase of the season, the 12 teams play a round-robin tournament whereby each team plays each of the other teams three times. After 33 games, the league splits into two sections of six teams, with each team playing each other once in that section. The league attempts to balance the fixture list so that teams in the same section play each other twice at home and twice away, but sometimes this is impossible. A total of 228 matches were played, with 38 matches played by each team.

The [[Scottish Professional Football League|SPFL]] Premiership manager of the year was [[Derek McInnes]] of [[Kilmarnock F.C.|Kilmarnock]].
 
The [[Scottish Professional Football League|SPFL]] Premiership player of the year was [[Lawrence Shankland]] of [[Heart of Midlothian F.C.|Heart of Midlothian]].

==Premiership play-offs==
The quarter-final was contested by the teams placed third and fourth in the [[2023–24 Scottish Championship#League summary|2023–24 Scottish Championship]], [[Partick Thistle F.C.|Partick Thistle]] and [[Airdrieonians F.C.|Airdrieonians]]. Partick Thistle advanced to the semi-final to face the team placed second in the Championship, [[Raith Rovers F.C.|Raith Rovers]]. The final was contested by Raith Rovers and the team placed eleventh in the Premiership, [[Ross County F.C.|Ross County]], who won the tie to secure a place in the [[2024–25 Scottish Premiership]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://spfl.co.uk/news/spfl-play-off-schedule-202324 |title=SPFL play-off schedule 2023/24 |publisher=SPFL |date=25 April 2024 |access-date=3 May 2024}}</ref>
